test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What percentage of the rural population uses safe and functional toilets as per the 2019-20 National Sample Survey report?
solution:
The correct answer is **__95%.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the results of NARSS 2019-20, 99.6% of the households who had access to toilets, and had availability of water, and **95.2%** of the rural population who had access to a toilet, were using it.
 
• Government launched Jal Jeevan Mission in 2019 with the goal to provide functional household tap connection to every rural household by 2024.
 
• According to 2019 data, **98.21%** of the country has achieved ODF Status and has full access to toilets.
 
• The National Annual Rural Sanitation Survey, 2019-2020, showed that **0.8 percent** of the population in rural areas had no toilets and practiced open defecation; the figure was 6.8 per cent in 2018-2019; and 23 percent in 2017-2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• A recent joint monitoring program(JMP) on water, sanitation, and hygiene by the World Health Organization and UNICEF released July 1, 2021, stated that at least 15 percent of the total population in India defecates in the open. 
 
• The Joint Monitoring Report also emphasized universal access to water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) to achieve the United Nations-mandated Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) .​
 
• According to census 2011 data, only **30.7%** of rural households had access to toilets in 2011. According to rural sanitation scheme data, the number was considerably larger at 79.9%.
 
• **Over 67 per cent** of rural households do not have access to toilets, according to government data.
